summary: An integrated health-monitoring and predictive wellness platform designed to track astronauts' vital signs, mental well-being, and physical fitness during long-duration space missions.
details:
​Problem: During extended space missions, astronauts face severe physiological and psychological challenges—such as muscle atrophy, bone density loss, sleep disruption, radiation exposure, and isolation stress. Continuous, real-time monitoring and early intervention are critical to ensuring crew safety and mission success.

​Solution: AstroCare is a conceptual smart health-tracking and decision-support system designed for astronauts. It integrates wearable biometric sensors with an AI-driven dashboard to continuously monitor heart rate, sleep quality, stress levels, nutrition, and exercise routines.

​Key Features:

​Real-Time Vitals & Stress Tracking: Detects early signs of fatigue, dehydration, or psychological stress and alerts both the astronaut and Mission Control.

​Personalized Fitness & Nutrition Plans: Recommends daily microgravity workout routines and hydration/nutrition adjustments based on real-time body metrics.

​Offline Autonomous Guidance: Works independently without continuous Earth communication, making it reliable for deep-space missions.

​Impact: By combining preventive healthcare with simple, user-friendly analytics, AstroCare helps maintain astronaut health, boosts productivity, and reduces medical risks in space.
